_note: Canvas is authored at the 1080-short-side size; 4K is a render-time upscale (--resolution landscape-4k / portrait-4k). Safe = px insets for every word and key UI. 9x16 = union of Meta Reels (top 14%, bottom 35%), TikTok (top 220-240, bottom 480-660, right 140) and Shorts (top 225, bottom 575): x 70..940, y 270..1240; y 1240..1360 only for non-essential text. 4x5 and 1x1 keep the centre of Instagram's 3:4 grid crop (1012 px and 810 px wide). 16x9 = 10% title safe. Loudness: master -14 LUFS integrated, -1.0 dBTP for every platform. Sources: research/platforms.md

loudness.note: mix.wav is limited to -1.3 dBTP so the AAC encode in the MP4 stays <= -1.0 dBTP (measured 2026-10-21: AAC adds ~0.1-0.3 dB)
